name: browser-use
headline: Manage isolated environments with sandbox skill
short_description: Agent sandbox skill manages isolated execution environments for AI agents. Enables safe code execution, full-stack app building, and engineering tasks. Integrates with E2B Sandboxes, supports Claude agents.
author: disler

sections.overview:
Agent Sandbox Skill provides isolated execution environments powered by E2B Sandboxes, allowing AI agents like Claude and Gemini to safely run untrusted code, install packages, and build complete full-stack applications without affecting your local system. The skill offers full isolation, allowing multiple independent agent forks to scale compute workloads securely. Built-in features include browser automation via Playwright, persistent context management across agent turns, and structured prompts optimized for CLI agents. This is ideal for engineers who need their AI agents to handle code execution, testing, and application scaffolding tasks autonomously while maintaining security and control.
Safe execution of untrusted code and scripts in isolated environments
Full-stack web application scaffolding and deployment with Vue, FastAPI, and SQLite
Automated testing and validation of code changes in sandboxes
Browser automation and visual testing of web applications
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/disler/agent-sandbox-skill`
sections.usage:
```
Set up an isolated agent sandbox environment for [TASK] using E2B Sandboxes. Install required dependencies, execute [COMMAND], and return the output. Ensure the environment is cleaned up after execution. Use the following command structure: 'e2b sandbox create --template [TEMPLATE] --command "[COMMAND]"'.
```
Copy

```
```
Sandbox Environment Created: sandbox-abc123
Template: python-3.11-full
Command Executed: pip install requests && python app.py

Output:
=== Requests Installation ===
Collecting requests
  Downloading requests-2.31.0-py3-none-any.whl (62 kB)
     ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 62.6/62.6 kB 1.2 MB/s
Installing collected packages: requests
Successfully installed requests-2.31.0

=== App Execution ===
Starting weather data fetch...
API Response: {"city": "San Francisco", "temp": 68, "conditions": "Partly Cloudy"}
Data processed and saved to /tmp/weather.json

Sandbox Cleanup: Terminated sandbox-abc123
```
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
